title: AUDITA: certified auditing and causal attribution of adverse outcomes in autonomous multi-agent systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.22160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physical automation is scaling toward fleets of embodied machines commanded by an AI brain. Early deployments already run factories and warehouses at production rates beyond any human line, and their adoption is accelerating. But when their joint decisions cause harm, everyone involved has reason to blame everyone else, the machine vendor, the algorithm provider, the factory operator, the insurer, and the regulator, and no method can divide the responsibility between them. Existing methods read logs whose origin they cannot verify and name a single culprit, misrepresenting outcomes that are overdetermined, preempted, or caused by an omission. We present \audita{}, an audit layer pairing a tamper-evident record of every inter-agent command with a certified, graded causal-attribution engine. We prove its verdict cannot be gamed: a rule-following agent can never be made to look guilty, an attempt to shift blame is itself caught and graded,

translated_title: AUDITA：自主多智能体系统中不良结果的认证审计与因果归因
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22160v1 公告类型：新 摘要：物理自动化正朝着由AI大脑指挥的具身机器人群体的规模发展。早期部署已在工厂和仓库中以超越任何人工生产线的速度运行，其应用正在加速。但当它们的联合决策造成伤害时，所有相关方都有理由相互指责——机器供应商、算法提供商、工厂运营商、保险公司和监管机构，而没有任何方法能在它们之间划分责任。现有方法读取来源无法验证的日志，并指定单一罪魁祸首，错误地代表了被过度决定、被抢先或由遗漏导致的结果。我们提出\audita{}，一个审计层，将每个智能体间命令的防篡改记录与认证的、分级的因果归因引擎配对。我们证明其裁决无法被操纵：一个遵守规则的智能体永远不会被弄得看起来有罪，而试图推卸责任的行为本身也会被发现并分级。
tldr: 本文提出AUDITA，一个结合防篡改记录和认证分级因果归因引擎的审计层，确保在多智能体系统中责任分配无法被操纵，并能公正地识别和分级不良后果的责任。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AUDITA, an audit layer combining tamper-evident records with a certified graded causal-attribution engine, ensuring that responsibility for adverse outcomes in multi-agent systems cannot be gamed and is fairly identified and graded.
